0022600191.text: The Knicks (4-4, 7th in the East) visit the Cavaliers (4-4, 6th in the East) for New York's ninth game of the season, with Cleveland on a two-game losing streak and New York on a two-game winning streak. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury; this season he is averaging 8.6 points and 31.7 minutes per game. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 130-93 win in Cleveland.
